ctrl: # manual corrections of a variable's initial value (control constants changed in the field after the snapshot was taken).
# Loaded on every build / xref-reload: value replaces the snapshot's only while the snapshot still holds `was` (status
# applied). Once a newer snapshot already holds `value` the row is reported as merged and can be deleted; a snapshot that
# holds neither is a conflict and the row is NOT applied. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# The header line must stay exactly ctrl
name: name
basis: basis (otherwise nothing is applied). A blank value or was

name: a value that is not a plain number for a numeric constant

ctrl: # other than 6 fields is a conflict and is NOT applied.
